text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Such power... it's stronger than before...
text_block_list.orig_text:
くっ……
すごい力……
これまで以上だね……！

text_block_list.name: Myu~chan
text_block_list.orig_text:
みゅみゅみゅ……
みゅっ！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: Myu-chan... Standing before us, huh? You're doing it! Hehe♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
みゅ～ちゃん……！
ミソギたちの前に立つなんて、
やるじゃん！
えへへ♪

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.orig_text:
……強くなったね、
みゅ～ちゃん。

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.orig_text: ミミたちも負けてられないねっ。

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: Yeah! This is really the last time! Let's combine our strength and do our best!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん！
これがほんとに最後の最後！
力を合わせて、
がんばろう！
